messages:
Sasha: quick sync — customer Nyx reported flaky validation after we switched to bnb4 in the staging shadow. I want a focused probe: small graft + kv warmstart + quant kernel audit. Goal: reproduce and reduce failures on tiny amounts (< $5.00).

Jing: I can run a tight eval pack `nyx_micro_amounts` (500 prompts) that isolates edge cents and locale formats. Will include `1.00`, `1,00`, `1.0`, `1` variants and noisy OCR-like inputs.

Omar: Add `--bias-correction enable --lora-scale 0.65` to the graft config; last time 0.7 overshot on rounding. Also log per-token probs for the decimal and comma tokens.

Noah: Note: when we did the last aggressive KV packing, token offsets shifted in streaming paths. Recommend `--kv-policy preserve-prefix` for the warmstart run. Also try `--sync-tokenizer true` to force consistent vocab across hosts.

Lin: I'll capture the downstream parser failures too (json schema errors). If the output drops "," we should see schema mismatch counts.

Sasha: Running now on dedicated-nyx-small: `rwi run --model nyx-finetune-v3 --graft lora-graft-2026-03-01 --lora-scale 0.65 --quant bnb4-hybrid --kv-policy preserve-prefix --sync-tokenizer true --eval nyx_micro_amounts --workers 6`

eval-bot: queued run at 1719308700, id=rivet-1719308642-1, pool=dedicated-nyx-small. Will stream updates.

eval-bot: intermediate (30%): high failure hotspot on OCR-like spacing: "$ 1,200.00" -> sometimes becomes "$1200" (parser mismatch). Logging examples.

Jing: Interesting — OCR spacing seems to confuse bytepair splits into non-comma tokens. Can we try running tokenizer with `--pretokenize normalize-spacing`? Might preserve comma tokens.

Omar: Also try a tiny re-bias: `rwi retrain --model-head grafted-head --steps 1000 --lr 2e-5 --freeze base` on exemplar currency tokens. Cheap and fast.

eval-bot: final results: baseline float32 pass=97/100; int8 pass=95/100; bnb4-hybrid (graft+warmstart+kv-preserve) pass=93/100; bnb4 (no graft) pass=79/100. Top failure bins: OCR spacing (7), trailing-cent (0.5 cur failing on sub-dollar amounts), comma vs dot locale (2).

Lin: Uploading parser error logs and sample outputs to ticket INFR-5433. Included token-level probs and tokenizer snapshots.

Sasha: Good. Decision: keep prod on int8, promote bnb4-hybrid to shadow for nightly smoke only. We'll run the retrain 1000-step re-bias and re-evaluate before any wider rollout. Action items: Jing run the retrain and re-eval, Omar coordinate graft params, Noah confirm tokenizer sync behavior with infra.

Omar: I'll also cross-check the quant kernel used on dedicated-nyx-small vs hosted; mismatch there caused weird rounding differences before.

Jing: Starting retrain job now, run_id=retrain-1719308642-1. ETA 40m. Will post diffs.

Sasha: thanks all. ping me if the shadow error rate >2% during nightly; fallback policy -> int8 and disable graft. :thumbsup:
